listing.name: Blast Corps (BlastCorps: Recompiled)
listing.summary: A native Blast Corps player for your own North American revision 1.1 dump.

steps.title: Keep the complete Windows player
steps.instruction: Keep the BlastCorps Recompiled 1.1.1 Windows package files together: BlastCorpsRecompiled.exe, assets, matching DLLs and notices. The ordinary published player does not need a game compiler or separate installer.

steps.title: Select your own supported original
steps.instruction: Choose your own North American revision 1.1 Blast Corps ROM through the upstream player. The selected game is bc.n64.us. Keep the original separately; this guide does not acquire, copy, authenticate or convert the ROM through Core.

steps.title: Review launch details, then choose Play
steps.instruction: Select BlastCorpsRecompiled.exe, its established package directory and supported literal arguments. Review the launch details, add the game, then choose Play. Preparation and runtime replacement stay with the player/upstream. Removing the registration preserves every external file; Core supplies no external engine update, backup, rollback, conversion, migration or deletion.

warnings: The package includes the Suplexmentary Comic NC font that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

Keep a complete separate backup and compatible creating engine; runtime replacement does not rewind saves or certify mods. A custom profile remains external. Close the actual player before deliberate replacement and review/relink a changed executable.

references.title: Preserve the actual profile before maintenance
references.instruction: The normal Windows profile is %LOCALAPPDATA%/BlastCorpsRecompiled. A portable.txt marker chooses the working directory; failed known-folder lookup can also fall back to a relative folder. Preserve the actual selected location, including cached bc.n64.us.z64 original, saves, settings/config JSON and backups/temporary files, mods and mod configuration. Keep a complete separate backup and compatible creating engine; runtime replacement does not rewind saves or certify mods. A custom profile remains external. Close the actual player before deliberate replacement and review/relink a changed executable.
